segmentation.text: shall not stand or park such vehicle
at any place other than in a taxicab stand so designated as provided herein.
This provision shall not prevent the operator of a taxicab from temporarily stopping
in accordance with other stopping or parking regulations
at any place for the purpose of and while actually engaged in the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers.

elements.justification: 'taxicab' is a defined term whose admitted aggregate is DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab ('a motor vehicle which is properly licensed under State and local law to provide taxicab service'); claimed as the aggregate, never as ru.taxicab. 'The operator of' is read through the taxicab's controlled motion (agency narrowing).

'stand' (DEF-NRS-484A-250: 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, otherwise than for the purpose of and while actually engaged in receiving or discharging passengers') contains 'park' (DEF-NRS-484A-155: 'the standing of a vehicle ... otherwise than temporarily'), so 'stand or park' is standing. drv.motion.parked denotes the road user at rest at every observation of a window of length min_duration ('A halt shorter than min_duration ... is not denoted'); with min_duration = p.standing_min_duration the purpose exclusion of the definition is read through the halt's duration (purpose narrowing). 'such vehicle' is the taxicab, and 'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, which the taxicab carries. Same concept as the index's 'shall: Not stand or park such vehicle'.

'street' (DEF-NRS-484A-265: 'the entire width between the boundary lines of every highway inside the territorial limits of a city') is a highway: st.highway is 'the entire public way between its boundary lines, including sidewalks and shoulders' and is not a stand-in for the roadway, which the words do not narrow to. The city-limit qualification is the territorial scope of this city ordinance, within which every highway is a street. rel.occupies anchors the taxicab to the way. Same atoms as the index's 'upon any street'.

'taxicab stand' (DEF-NRS-484B-067: 'a fixed area in a highway parallel and adjacent to the curb or edge of the highway and set aside for taxicabs to stand for passengers') is st.curb_zone of kind taxicab_stand ('a signed or marked length of curb; kind ∈ {..., taxicab_stand, ...}'); rel.occupies ('a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (..., curb zone, ...)') places the standing taxicab in it. 'so designated as provided herein' is read by the presence of the signed or marked stand (status narrowing).

'temporarily stopping' (stopping, DEF-NRS-484A-260: 'any halting, even momentarily, of a vehicle') is a halt of the taxicab: drv.motion.complete_halt, 'at rest at the observation'. A halt that ends before p.standing_min_duration is not drv.motion.parked, so the temporary stop the words protect is outside the obligation of s2.

'for the purpose of and while actually engaged in the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers' is a purpose, read through the halt's duration: a halt no longer than p.standing_min_duration, the passenger pick-up dwell at the curb, is not drv.motion.parked with that min_duration ('A halt shorter than min_duration, which may be the temporary halt the definition leaves out, is not denoted'), so it is excused 'at any place'.

residues.why: 'This provision shall not prevent' a temporary passenger stop: the words leave such a stop to the other stopping and parking regulations, which judge it by their own rules. A temporary stop that breaches another regulation is that regulation's violation; under this provision it is neither standing nor parking (DEF-NRS-484A-250, DEF-NRS-484A-155), so this rule's verdict is the same whether or not the stop complies with the others.

applicability: The subject is a taxicab (ru.aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab, a vehicle) whose footprint overlaps a highway (rel.occupies, st.highway) at the observation.
obligation: Wherever the subject stands — drv.motion.parked(subject) with speed_tol = p.halt_speed_tolerance and min_duration = p.standing_min_duration, i.e. at rest at every observation of the last p.standing_min_duration — its footprint overlaps a curb zone of kind taxicab_stand (rel.occupies, st.curb_zone). A halt shorter than p.standing_min_duration, the temporary stop for loading or unloading passengers, is not standing and is compliant at any place.

narrowings.why: 'The operator of a taxicab' is read through the taxicab's controlled motion and halts, whoever or whatever controls it.

The definitions' exclusion of a halt 'for the purpose of and while actually engaged in receiving or discharging passengers' is read through the halt's duration: standing is a halt longer than p.standing_min_duration.
'so designated as provided herein' is read by the presence of the signed or marked taxicab_stand curb zone.
The purpose of loading or unloading passengers is read through a halt no longer than p.standing_min_duration.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A taxicab halts at the curb of a city highway, outside any taxicab_stand curb zone, and stays at rest for 5 minutes.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A taxicab halts within a taxicab_stand curb zone of the highway and stays at rest for 5 minutes.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A taxicab stands for 5 minutes in a private parking lot whose footprint lies on no highway.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A taxicab is at the curb of a highway outside any taxicab stand for 5 minutes; the source supplies no speed, so whether it stands is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A taxicab halts 30 seconds at the curb outside any taxicab stand, a passenger boards, and it drives off: the halt is a temporary stop, not standing.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_12_070_B; speed resolution of the acquisition standard

param_proposals.name: p.standing_min_duration
param_proposals.convention: the longest halt counted as receiving or discharging passengers or loading rather than standing: a passenger pick-up dwell at the curb
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_52_040_A; curbside passenger dwell times of taxi and ride-hail pick-up studies
